fde_assumptions_and_policy.passenger_count_nulls: Preserved in clean dataset for operational and revenue KPIs; excluded only for per-passenger metrics. Dropping 29.2% of nulls would severely bias trip volume.
fde_assumptions_and_policy.ratecode_id_nulls: Mapped to 'Unassigned / Digital Dispatch' rather than dropping.
fde_assumptions_and_policy.quarantine_policy: Records failing physical travel laws (speed > 85mph, negative fares, duration < 1m) are segregated to quarantine parquet with diagnostic tags for vendor SLA reviews.
